root_cause.text: The mtk-smi common/larb probe and remove paths leaked a device reference because the looked-up `smi_common_dev` obtained an extra refcount that was not released on late probe failure or driver unbind.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds missing `put_device()` calls in both the larb probe error path (`err_pm_disable:` after `device_link_remove(dev, larb->smi_common_dev);`) and the common remove path (`mtk_smi_common_remove()` after `pm_runtime_disable(&pdev->dev);`), while the CVE/commit message explicitly says to “drop the reference taken when looking up the SMI device during common probe on late probe failure (e.g. probe deferral) and on driver unbind.”

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The mtk-smi common/larb probe and remove paths leaked a device reference because the looked-up `smi_common_dev` obtained an extra refcount that was not released on late probe failure or driver unbind.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch adds missing `put_device()` calls in both the larb probe error path (`err_pm_disable:` after `device_link_remove(dev, larb->smi_common_dev);`) and the common remove path (`mtk_smi_common_remove()` after `pm_runtime_disable(&pdev->dev);`), while the CVE/commit message explicitly says to “drop the reference taken when looking up the SMI device during common probe on late probe failure (e.g. probe deferral) and on driver unbind.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Release the smi_common_dev device reference in the probe failure cleanup path to fix a reference leak.
intent_record.what: A call to put_device(larb->smi_common_dev) was added in the err_pm_disable error-handling path of mtk_smi_larb_probe(), immediately after device_link_remove(dev, larb->smi_common_dev) and before returning ret.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this releases the reference to smi_common_dev that was previously retained when probe fails along this path, preventing a leaked device reference and ensuring proper cleanup during error handling.

intent_record.intent_summary: Release the smi_common_dev device reference during remove to fix a refcount leak in teardown.
intent_record.what: A call to put_device(common->smi_common_dev) was added at the end of mtk_smi_common_remove() after pm_runtime_disable(&pdev->dev).
intent_record.how: This releases a reference to common->smi_common_dev during device removal, ensuring the referenced device's refcount is decremented and preventing a leaked device reference from persisting after teardown.

grouping_result.intent: Release the smi_common_dev device reference during remove to fix a refcount leak in teardown.

consistency_review.core_intent: Release the smi_common_dev device reference in both failure and teardown paths to fix a reference count leak.

relevance_review.reason: The changes explicitly release the extra smi_common_dev device reference in the probe failure and remove paths, directly addressing the described refcount leak on late probe failure and driver unbind.

candidates.rationale: This cleanup path removed the device link but, before the fix, did not drop the extra reference held on larb->smi_common_dev after lookup. It is the teardown point directly associated with the late probe failure leak.
Probe exits here after partial cleanup, causing the leaked smi_common_dev reference to persist because no put_device/of_node_put-equivalent release was performed before returning.
During remove, this detached the device link but did not release the referenced common->smi_common_dev object itself, embodying the unbind-time reference count leak.
This function continued teardown and returned without any release of common->smi_common_dev, so the missing put on the referenced device remained after driver removal.

vuln_statements.explanation: This probe failure cleanup removed only the device link for larb->smi_common_dev but did not drop the extra device reference acquired from the lookup, directly causing the late probe failure reference leak described in the root cause.
This remove-path teardown detached the device link from common->smi_common_dev but failed to release the held device reference itself, causing the unbind-time refcount leak.

bic_trace_step.reason: The snippet is sufficient because it shows the full error-handling logic added in `mtk_smi_larb_probe()` around the relevant `component_add()` failure path. The root cause is a leaked reference to `smi_common_dev` acquired earlier and not released on probe failure or remove. In this commit, the new failure path after `ret = component_add(dev, &mtk_smi_larb_component_ops);` does `pm_runtime_disable(dev);` and `device_link_remove(dev, larb->smi_common_dev);` before returning.
